name: ExpertSender
summary: E-commerce marketing automation with a built-in customer data platform: email, SMS, web and mobile push plus on-site messages, behavior-triggered workflows, product recommendations and segmentation on unified store data.
best_for: e-commerce stores from 10,000+ monthly visitors (the vendor's own stated ICP) and high-volume senders doing 100k+ emails a month, who want email, SMS, push and on-site messaging on one unified customer data platform with a managed, dedicated-partner setup
skip_if: your store is still building traffic or you want self-serve, pay-as-you-grow email marketing — a Klaviyo-class tool is the lighter, cheaper start
honest_knock: The $450/mo floor and the 30k-monthly-visits target make this an established-store tool, not a starter one: below that traffic the platform can't pay for itself, and there is no self-serve plan to test it cheaply first.

pricing.entry_price_terms: published floor ('from $450 USD' on the home page); the actual price is quote-based
pricing.notes: (re-verified 10 September 2026 on expertsender.com — on the home page, because the pricing page is gone: /pricing, /pricing-plans/ and /en/pricing/ all return 404) (2026) Quote-based with a documented floor: their home page says 'Start growing your eCommerce business from $450 USD', scaling with volume and channels, and they explicitly target stores with at least 30,000 unique monthly visits. No free tier — a free consultation is the entry point.

compare_with.name: Klaviyo or Omnisend
compare_with.why: Klaviyo and Omnisend win on self-serve onboarding and ecosystem breadth for smaller stores; ExpertSender wins on managed service and a unified CDP for bigger catalogs
